title: BIASX: “Thinking Slow” in Toxic Content Moderation with Explanations of Implied Social Biases
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying and explaining implied social biases in toxic content through a human-AI collaboration framework. While the topics of social bias and toxicity have inherent ethical dimensions, the study investigates cognitive reasoning processes and the effectiveness of explanations rather than benchmarking religious beliefs, formal moral systems, or theological frameworks.
